meta.description: Use this when setting up claude-mem on Cursor: local or remote worker, local host-login observer or remote cmem.ai inference.

copy.tagline: 在 Cursor 中完成本地或远程的记忆服务配置，让 AI 助手记住上下文。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在 Cursor 里编程，希望 AI 助手能跨会话记住内容。
copy.tagline_en: Set up a memory service for Cursor with local or remote options.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code in Cursor and want your AI assistant to remember context.

howto.what: 为 Cursor 安装 claude-mem:默认启动本地 worker,插件自带 hooks,MCP 服务 claude-mem-local 与它通信;也可装成远程 worker。
howto.when: 当你要在 Cursor 上设置 claude-mem,选择本地或远程 worker、观察者用本机登录或 cmem.ai 远程推理时。

say.text: 帮我在 Cursor 装 claude-mem 本地 worker
say.note: 执行安装命令,插件自带 hooks

say.text: 装成远程 worker,server-url 填我的主机地址
say.note: 改用 server 运行时并指向你的主机

say.text: 观察者改用本机登录,加 --provider host

howto.what_en: Sets up claude-mem on Cursor: starts the local worker, hooks ship with the plugin, and the claude-mem-local MCP talks to it. Also supports a remote worker, with the observer on host login or cmem.ai remote inference.
howto.when_en: Use when installing claude-mem on Cursor, choosing a local or remote worker and an observer that uses local host login or cmem.ai remote inference.

say_en.text: Install claude-mem on Cursor as the local worker
say_en.note: Runs the install command; hooks come with the plugin

say_en.text: Set it up as a remote worker with my server URL
Switch the observer to local host login
say_en.note: Adds --provider host; loopback shim on port 37778
